items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: Red Nichols was smart enough to recognize that these guys had something... And so he just took them all over... as members of his band.

ctx.x: It was too progressive to have understood it.

They treated it as if it were a Spike Jones record, particularly when Tash would be a quarter tone off, some of those high things. They couldn't understand that at all. And, uh, but that wasn't the case when the, when the boys actually came east. They came east at a miserable time because there, there, there just wasn't much money to be made in it. But, uh, Red Nichols was smart enough to recognize that these guys had something that, that his tricky little man never would have in, at all. And so he just took them…
Yeah, he used them in the recording and in the band and so forth, yes. Um, the, uh...
